macro.m_description: Every hour on the hour, shows one silent notification naming the hour to log. Tapping it opens the Lifelog HUD. Holds no state and captures no data.

m_actionList.m_notificationText: Needed, Wanted or Drifted, then one sentence.

aiFeedback: Fires RegularIntervalTrigger every 3600s with m_ignoreReferenceStartTime=false and a 00:00 reference, so intervals align to the top of each hour rather than to whenever the macro was enabled; m_useAlarm=true asks for alarm-manager precision so Doze does not slide it. The notification is channel type 1 (Silent) at priority -1 (Low) so it never makes a sound, and m_overwriteExisting with a fixed notificatonId (771) means each hour replaces the previous one instead of stacking a tower of them. Tap-to-open is a configuredActionJson holding a serialised OpenWebPageAction. VERIFY TWO THINGS ON THE PHONE: (1) TimeOfDayConstraint 06:00-01:00 crosses midnight, which the schema does not confirm - if pings stop after midnight or never fire at all, just delete the constraint; the notification is silent, so a 3am one costs nothing. (2) m_imageResourceName 'fa_clock' is a guess at the built-in icon name - if the notification shows a blank or default icon, pick one in the UI. Everything else is taken directly from the schema.
